findings.fact: ARKO is a pnpm/Turbo monorepo; the user-management feature is in the apps/web Next.js 15.5, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, tRPC 11, NextAuth 5 beta, and Jest workspace, backed by the packages/db Prisma 6 workspace
User authorization is currently based on a Prisma Role enum and a hard-coded role-to-permission map; ADMIN grants every permission through a wildcard
The admin-only user API creates users with a fixed role, updates roles, increments authVersion on access changes, and manages ACTIVE, RESTRICTED, and SUSPENDED account status
Only ACTIVE users may sign in or retain a session; role and authVersion are refreshed from the database
The user-management UI currently presents fixed permission-level buttons and uses existing semantic theme tokens and responsive modal/page patterns
Relevant installed Next.js documentation must be read before code changes
